title: 第一卷 第21章 秦秀云洞房第一卷 第22章 沐晴的眼泪
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 苏沐风忍不住破口大骂道。
林逸没有理会苏沐风的扰乱，眼眸始终看着秀美可人的秦秀云，满脸认真问道。
苏有福和苏沐风，横插一杠，恶意抬价。
而这五亩灵田，又是他增加云梦城林氏底蕴的绝佳机会。
若是这一次错失了机会。
下一次其他人卖田，还会第一时间告诉他么？
就算告诉他，他能争得过苏有福么？
以后再想得到灵田，希望就很渺茫了。
这一次，他无论如何都要把握住。
绝不让它从自己面前溜走。
娶秦秀云，这是他急中生智。
但若是真能娶到手，本命仙族灵树，肯定还能再结出一枚仙灵果。
又能白白得到五亩灵田。
秦秀云眼眶泛红，看着林逸真诚的眼神，想起丈夫死后这些年的艰辛，想起林逸对她们娘俩的照拂，想起刚才林逸为了保护颜如玉挺身而出的担当。
秦秀云声音哽咽，眼泪掉了下来。
“秀云，你放心，我会好好待你，也会把灵儿当亲生女儿！”
林逸握住她的手，粗糙的掌心贴着她纤细的手指，温声道。
他面上惯有的淡淡微笑，消失不见。
自己这么有钱，竟然还能输给林逸这个老头。
“你种植青灵稻，等着被我压价吧！”
苏有福甩袖离去，临走还不忘威胁。
content_en:
"This is so shameless!"
"How can it still be like this?"
Su Mufeng couldn't help but cursed loudly.
"Xiuyun, I mean it!"
"I will definitely be good to you and Ling'er!"
"Will you marry me?"
Lin Yi ignored Su Mufeng's disturbance and kept looking at the beautiful Qin Xiuyun, asking seriously.
Su Youfu and Su Mufeng interfered and maliciously raised the price.
Gradually increase prices.
He couldn't compete at all.
And these five acres of spiritual land are an excellent opportunity for him to increase the foundation of the Lin family in Yunmeng City.
If the opportunity is missed this time.
Next time someone else sells their land, will they tell him immediately?
Even if I told him, would he be able to compete with Su Youfu?
If you want to get the spiritual field in the future, your hope will be slim.
This time, he had to grasp it no matter what.
Seize this opportunity fiercely.
Never let it pass you by.
Marrying Qin Xiuyun was a wise act of desperation.
But if you can really get married, the natal fairy tree will definitely produce another fairy fruit.
And I can get five acres of spiritual land for free.
You can get another fairy fruit.
Where can I find such a good thing?
"Brother Yi!"
Qin Xiuyun's eyes were red, looking at Lin Yi's sincere eyes, thinking of the hardships in the years after her husband's death, thinking of Lin Yi's care for the two of them, and thinking of Lin Yi's responsibility to protect Yan Ruyu just now.
"I do!"
Qin Xiuyun's voice was choked and tears fell.
"Xiuyun, don't worry, I will treat you well and treat Ling'er as my biological daughter!"
Lin Yi held her hand, his rough palm pressed against her slender fingers, and said warmly.
"Okay! Okay! You...you..."
Su Youfu's face was ashen.
The usual faint smile on his face disappeared.
He didn't expect it at all.
He is so rich, but he can still lose to an old man like Lin Yi.
"Dad, let's go!"
"This old guy is shameless!"
Su Mufeng pulled her father.
"Lin Yi, don't be proud!"
"Marrying a widow is all you can do!"
"You grow Qingling rice and wait for my price to be lowered!"
Su Youfu threw up his sleeves and left, not forgetting the threat before leaving.
"Son-in-law, it's high! It's really high!"
Wang Kaishan clapped his hands and applauded.
